title: Free sheaf shifted Hom computes derived module global sections
statement: Let $Z$ be any scheme and $\Lambda$ any commutative ring. Let $\Lambda_Z$ be the sheafification of the free $\Lambda$-module presheaf on the representable of the terminal object $\mathrm{id}_Z$ of the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], equivalently the constant rank-one module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For every integer $q\geq 0$ there is a natural isomorphism of functors on sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] to abelian groups, $F\mapsto \operatorname{Hom}_{D^+(Z_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)}(\Lambda_Z[0],F[0][q])\cong F\mapsto U(H^q(R\Gamma(Z,F[0])))$, where $U$ forgets the module structure and cohomology and derived categories are as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. No compactness, separation, or torsion condition is imposed.

source.place: Tags 015A (definition-higher-derived-functors), 05TI (lemma-enough-injectives-right-derived), 070I (lemma-K-injective), and the equation after 03DI (equation-map-lower-shriek-OU-into-module); terminal object specialization and natural comparison written by J1

proof.text: Use the fully faithful bounded-below inclusion and its shift compatibility to identify shifted maps from the degree-zero terminal free sheaf with Ext. Mathlib Abelian.Ext.homAddEquiv realizes the derived Hom comparison. For an injective resolution R of F, Mathlib InjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass identifies Ext with degree-q cohomology classes of the Hom complex; its construction uses bounded-below K-injectivity and the K-injective Hom comparison. Reuse EtaleComparisonAux.extClass_naturality from the existing sheafH Ext-derived comparison module via a proof-only import all. This generic lemma proves injective Ext postcomposition naturality on representatives. The shifted-Hom comparison uses the shift isomorphism naturality.

Use the free-Yoneda sections adjunction, concretely Etale.freeSheafHomEquiv and freeSheafHomEquiv_comp, from the Hom identification in [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-free-separator]. Prove its additivity by freeSheafSections. Cochain.fromSingleEquiv gives a termwise additive isomorphism between the Hom complex and terminal sections of the resolution after forgetting module structure. Cochain.δ_fromSingleMk and naturality identify the differentials. Construct the induced cohomology-class isomorphism. Reuse the generic EtaleComparisonAux.postMap, postClass and homologyClass_naturality from the existing sheafH Ext-derived comparison module, rather than duplicating its postcomposition constructions or naturality theorems. Combine that homology naturality with the termwise sections isomorphism naturality. The exact module forgetful functor preserves homology, by ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso. Terminal evaluation is naturally isomorphic to global sections by Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections.

Apply InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex and its inverse naturality to identify the computed homology with the classical right derived functor of terminal sections. Transport along its natural isomorphism with global sections using NatTrans.rightDerived. The bounded-below/unbounded compatibility Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility and [lem-sp-derived-functor-single-identification], in its natural form singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorPlusCompHomologyFunctorIso, identify that functor with homology of unbounded derived global sections on F[0]. Package all additive component isomorphisms as natural isomorphisms and compose. All naturality equations use the same resolution lift and are proved explicitly, so no separate invocation of a homotopy-invariance lemma is needed.

theorem nonempty_freeSheafDerivedSectionsIso (Z : Scheme.{u})
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0 ⋙ shiftFunctor _ (q : ℤ) ⋙
        preadditiveCoyoneda.obj
          (op ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((Etale.freeSheaf Λ Z).obj
              (MorphismProperty.Over.mk ⊤ (𝟙 Z) (inferInstance : Etale (𝟙 Z))))))) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) 0 ⋙
          Etale.cohomology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Z (q : ℤ) ⋙
          forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
